origin: Named after the musical instrument whose bellows fold and unfold: sections fold and unfold to shrink and expand the content.
whenToUse: Content where people read only the items they need, such as an FAQ.
You organize long settings or information into sections on mobile.
The titles alone are enough to predict the content.
whenNotToUse: Most people need to read everything.
People need to compare the content of different sections.
The content is only a line or two, so there's no reason to fold it.

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.reason: Content at the same level, split sideways.

alternatives.name: Drawer
alternatives.reason: Details kept apart from the main content.

accessibility: Make each title a <button> inside a heading to support both document structure and keyboard use.
aria-expanded announces whether it's open, and aria-controls the panel it opens.
Connect each panel to its title with role="region" and aria-labelledby.
The arrow's rotation animation turns off with prefers-reduced-motion.
